# Reflection — Original Candidate

The original candidate correctly scopes the student role and prohibits scope creep. Its core design — absorb critique, revise minimally, expose reasoning, predict approval — is sound.

The six failure modes are all specification gaps rather than conceptual errors. None of the original content needs to be removed; the fixes are additive or clarifying replacements. This makes the optimized candidate a low-risk, high-confidence improvement over the original.
